story.title: Parvatamma's Virus
paragraphs_en: It has been 6 months since Shringeri Srinivas made his promise and his hair longer than ever. Now everything is going in the right way. In the news, he has see that Hyderabad has found a medcine and is testing and will launch it if successful on August 15 the Indepenence day. Everyone was very happy but Shringeri Srinivas is very worried. His wife Parvathamma has been ill and he thinks it is all because of him

She has been selling Srinivas's High Quality Banana Halwa and she has been touching many people and who knows if she has been washing her hands. He took her to an ayurvedic doctor and the ayurvedic doctor said "Give her a lot of rest". But it didn't work. He went to another doctor and he said the same thing. He went to many

doctors but they all said the same. Lately, he has been have having a very big frown. Today he had the largest frown and when he saw his face in the mirror he was so scared half his hair was gone. He thought to try for 1 last time. The doctor then said "Make your wife inhale a lot of hot air". Listening to the doctor, he bought a Steam Inhaler using his brand new phone. It said it will

arrive in 3 days. Parvatamma prayed to the god . Parvatamma's health was getting worser and by then Parvatamma could hardly breathe. Sringeri Srinivas did as the doctor said. Her health was getting a lot better. And by the end of 2 weeks, her health was better and she could breathe which meant that Parvathamma was getting better. And in a week she was as healthy she was
Sringeri Srinivas got to the centre and shouted " My wife has breathed warm air and she has recovered.
The tiger could hear it too. He secretly went into a room which contained a Steam Inhaler. He recovered too.
As Sringeri Srinivas promised he went to Bhimanna's Barbershop and cut his hair. Everyone was happy.
Yeah, for sure everyone was happy.
As Sringeri Srinivas promised he went to Bhimanna's Barbershop and cut his hair.
Everyone started singing because it was the first recovery in their village.
